item.title: Show HN: Sameshi – a ~1200 Elo chess engine that fits within 2KB
item.description:
📝 sameshi Watch Demo Video A minimal chess engine supporting a constrained subset of the game. 95 KB core 120 cell mailbox board negamax search alpha beta pruning material only eval capture first move ordering full legal move validation (check / mate / stalemate) Notenot implemented: castling, en passant, promotion, repetition, 50-move rule. strength ~1170 Elo (95% CI: 1110-1225) 240 games vs stockfish (1320-1600 levels) fixed depth 5, constrained rules, max 60 plies.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/datavorous/sameshi

item.title: How many registers does an x86-64 CPU have? (2020)
item.description:
📝 I will count registers that are present on x86-64 CPUs, but that can’t be used in long mode. I won’t count microarchitectural implementation details, like shadow registers. I will count registers that aren’t directly addressable, like MSRs that can only be accessed through RDMSR.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.yossarian.net/2020/11/30/How-many-registers-does-an-x86-64-cpu-have
